Home.hubQuickTitle: Popular tools to try right now
Home.aboutBody1: LifeHub brings together practical calculators and conversion tools across 8 categories — Life & Health, Finance & Investment, Image & Media, Documents & PDF, Fun & Entertainment, Mini Games, Dev & IT, and General Utilities — all in one free service. No sign-up or installation is required; just search for a tool or browse by category and start using it right away.
Home.aboutBody2: Most tools process your input entirely in your browser rather than sending it to a server. You can enter sensitive numbers like loan amounts or asset details without worrying about them leaving your device. See our Privacy Policy page for the full details.
Home.aboutBody3: LifeHub was built for anyone who wants to track everyday health metrics, plan a loan or retirement savings strategy, convert photo or document file formats, or reach for a quick encoding or decoding tool while coding — a genuinely wide range of everyday needs.
Home.aboutBody4: LifeHub currently offers over 200 tools in four languages — Korean, English, Japanese, and Spanish — and new tools are added regularly based on user feedback. If there's a tool you'd like to see, feel free to suggest it on our Contact page.
Home.aboutBody5: There are many calculator sites out there, but LifeHub stands out by requiring no sign-up and processing most calculations instantly in your browser. It also brings health, finance, image, document, entertainment, and dev tools together in one place, so you don't need to hop between different sites.
Home.aboutBody6: Every tool on LifeHub is designed to work the same way on both desktop and mobile. You can run a calculation right from your phone's browser while out and about, with no app installation required.
Home.aboutBody7: Every tool on LifeHub is completely free, and there's no paid plan or subscription required to unlock any feature. The plan going forward is to keep the core calculation tools free.
Home.aboutBody8: Many past user suggestions have already turned into new tools or feature improvements. If a specific calculator's result looks off, or there's an input field you wish it had, even a small note through the Contact page is genuinely useful and often shapes the next update.
